findings.summary: The newly written host-guarded matrix explanation misstates which facts unskip and what the 44 remaining skips are.
findings.detail: docs/release/build-and-release.md lines 87-90 say the host-guarded run unskips 'the pinned-host route, discovery, native-Skia, and package-content facts' and that 'the remaining 44 skips are the pre-existing non-canonical cross-runtime golden set'. Independent skip-set diff (default vs host-guarded) shows the 19 unskipped facts are exclusively JellyfinHostFact-gated (JellyfinImageResponseTests 9, JellyfinImageRouteTests 5, PluginDiscoveryHostTests 2, DashboardSettingsPageTests 2, ConfigurationRoundTripTests 1); no native-Skia fact unskips with ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR. The 44 remaining host-guarded skips are the ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT-gated native-render/decode facts (SkiaBadgeRendererRenderTests 9, RenderPngContractTests 7, RendererBehavior*/RenderDeterminism*/RenderGolden/RenderOrientation/SkiaHostCompatibility/SourceImageDescriptor/JellyfinArtworkImageAccess), not the cross-runtime golden set; the only non-canonical cross-runtime gated fact is RendererCrossRuntimeTests.SuppliedNonCanonicalGoldenSetMatchesWithinTheAdr010Tolerance (ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS=1). The same mischaracterization appears in the changed docs/limitations.md V6 sentence 'The skips are the environment-guarded pinned-host facts and the pre-existing non-canonical cross-runtime golden set.' This mirrors a pre-existing (also imprecise) project taxonomy at limitations.md line 309-311, and the recorded counts themselves (default 1494/63/1557, host 1513/44/1557, forced-native 1575/20/1595) are all independently reproduced and correct. Non-blocking: it does not affect artifact identity, reproducibility, the manifest, or any acceptance criterion; flagging for the documentation owner.
evidence: comm -23 default-skips.txt host-skips.txt (19 unskipped, all JellyfinHostFact classes)
findings.recommended_action: Reword the parenthetical so it matches the guards: the pinned-host route/response, discovery, dashboard, and configuration facts unskip with ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR; the remaining 44 skips are the native-Skia/render/decode facts that require ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1; the non-canonical cross-runtime comparison requires ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS=1.
